title: GlobalID — Digital Identity & Fintech Platform
description: Denis Korinšek’s technical leadership and Android development on GlobalID, an international digital identity and financial services platform, as an engagement within Kamino from 2020 to 2023.
lede: Technical leadership and Android development for an international digital identity and financial services platform, as an engagement within Kamino.

meta.role: Android Tech Lead, Payments, then Team Lead

technical: Led the end-to-end Android integration enabling account linking, balance management, cryptocurrency trading and fund transfers.
Contributed to the architecture and implementation of an ERC-20 and Solana token wallet using Trust Wallet Core, including key management and transaction signing.
Developed an ERC-20 token on a private network that grew into a new business.
Developed digital identity verification and in-app chat features.
leadership: Technical lead for 4–5 Android developers, providing architectural guidance, code reviews and mentoring; remained on the project at the client’s request during the organizational transition.
Coordinated technical work across Android, iOS, backend and QA teams in Slovenia, the United States, Ukraine, Colombia and Egypt.
Resolved recurring Uphold integration blockers through direct collaboration with the external partner.
note: This summary covers my own contribution. It doesn’t describe the GlobalID product as a whole.
